Troubleshooting guide for common GC-MS issues (e.g., vacuum pressure, peak repeatability). Comparison of this alkaline extraction method to previous acidic phase separation methods, noting reduced volatility. 研究报道了健康奶牛血清中多种 SCFA（乙酸、丙酸、丁酸等）的浓度范围（例如乙酸 815–1922 µmol/L），并指出个体间存在巨大变异（2-20 倍）。文中对比了 LC-MS 与 GC-MS 方法，指出 LC-MS 在样本前处理时间和灵敏度上的优势。此外，研究强调了样本处理中防止挥发损失的重要性（如使用乙腈而非甲醇提取），并观察到不同体液 compartment（牛奶与血清）间特定 SCFA 存在强相关性。

outline_action: Use this study to describe the technical methodology for SCFA quantification in serum within the review. Explicitly note that this protocol covers SCFAs but not inosine. Highlight the lack of TME-specific protocols and cancer-specific reference ranges as a limitation in current standardization. query_audits.query_text: inosine short-chain fatty acids LC-MS/MS tumor microenvironment serum quantification method validation

What are the specific analytical protocols, such as LC-MS/MS parameters and sample processing standards, for quantifying absolute physiological concentrations of inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human tumor microenvironments or serum?

remaining_gap: This study does not provide a measurement protocol for inosine. It does not address sample preparation or quantification specifically for tumor microenvironment (TME) tissue, focusing only on serum and feces. The reference ranges cited are from a general metabolomics database (HMDB) rather than a cancer-specific consensus statement or standardized reference range for tumor patients. The success criterion regarding 'consensus statements' or 'reference ranges' for cancer contexts remains unmet.
useful_material: This study provides a detailed Basic Protocol 1 for quantifying 14 short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum and feces using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). It specifies alkaline extraction (pH > 7) using sodium hydroxide, derivatization with MTBSTFA at 60 °C, and specific GC-MS parameters (e.g., oven temperature program, ion source settings). It includes a table of 14 SCFA standards with retention times and quantification masses. It references the Human Metabolomics Database (HMDB) for normal concentration ranges of acetic acid in human blood (26.8 to 64.2 μM). It outlines calibration curve requirements (R2 ≥ 0.95) and sample storage conditions (−80 °C for long-term).

该研究建立并验证了一种用于生物样本（牛血清和牛奶）中短链脂肪酸（SCFA）绝对定量的 LC-MS 方法。核心方案包括使用 3-硝基苯肼（3-NPH）进行衍生化，结合反相液相色谱 - 质谱（RP-LC-MS）分析。方法学验证显示其具有高灵敏度（大多数分析物 LOD ≤ 0.1 µmol/L）、准确性（加标回收率 84–115%）和重现性（RSD < 7%）。该研究证明了在复杂生物基质（含脂质干扰）中检测挥发性 SCFA 的技术可行性，并提供了具体的衍生化反应条件（30°C, 30 min）和色谱分离参数。

This study describes the application of UHPLC-MS/MS to quantify short-chain fatty acids (specifically butyrate) in mouse plasma and feces, and GC-MS for tumor tissue, reporting measurable concentration changes linked to anti-PD-L1 therapy outcomes in a syngeneic NKTCL mouse model.
